decisions.reason: The financing structure does not change the capex values or shared-program capex presentation; the separate capex clause in the same message is already represented.
The specific financing assumptions remain subject to the existing requirement to annotate assumptions and do not alter the general documentation or unavailable-input policy.
Changing financing inputs does not change the required integrated three-statement structure or its financial-engine basis.
The debt/equity structure, financing rate, and mezzanine treatment do not change the operating-cost assumptions; the separate opex clause is already represented.
The financing decision does not alter the site count, site-list source, or site-level configuration basis; the separate site-list clause is already represented.
The approved financing assumptions may be used within the scenarios but do not change the required user-funded and PPP scenario definitions or justification.
The financing structure does not change the modeled revenue streams, pricing-assumption basis, or revenue-assumption documentation.
The financing decision does not change the CCA method, class examples, or modeled tax-shield effects; the separate tax and depreciation clause is already represented.
Financing assumptions affect model calculations but do not change the candidate's DSCR and equity-IRR sizing criteria, which are separately established in the same message.
The client-confirmed financing assumptions do not change the requirement to verify source data or the established hierarchy and role of reference sources.
The financing decision does not alter the model currency or 2026 price base year.
